visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor living room setting. A young man with short dark hair in a white jacket and beige trousers stands next to a young woman with long brown hair wearing a white fuzzy fleece and dark jeans. The man holds an orange, gesturing with his finger as the woman eats a segment. (2) The camera pans right as the man approaches another woman standing by a cabinet. She has glasses, a ponytail, and wears a white turtleneck and black skirt, holding a large clear water bottle. The man points at the orange he is holding. (3) Close-up shot focusing on the orange held by the man's hands as he demonstrates the 'head' versus the 'tail' of the fruit. Yellow and white subtitles appear at the bottom. (4) The camera returns to the first pair. The man looks at the off-screen cameraman while the woman in the fleece holds her orange segments, looking confused. High-contrast white lines appear over the scene for comedic effect. (5) A top-down close-up shot shows a hand peeling the stem end of an orange over a glass coffee table. Plastic containers and a pink bag are visible on the table. (6) A close-up of the woman in the white fleece. She attempts to peel the orange from the top, her fingernails digging into the skin. The scene turns to grayscale as she looks directly into the camera with a look of regret/defeat.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 三個麻瓜. [Subtitle]: 來喔～我問妳喔. (2) [Subtitle]: 妳剝橘子... 從「尾巴剝」 還是從「頭剝」? (3) [Subtitle]: 當然是「尾巴」啊！頭怎麼剝啊？ (4) [Variety]: (找到同好了!). (5) [Subtitle]: 小兵我問妳！過來過來. (6) [Subtitle]: 妳剝橘子... 從這邊「頭剝」? 還是「尾巴剝」? (7) [Subtitle]: 我不會剝橘子. (8) [Variety]: (原來是不會剝的部分). (9) [Subtitle]: 攝影師你是「從頭」還是「從尾」? (10) [Subtitle]: 我從... 這個是頭嗎? (11) [Subtitle]: 「頭」? (12) [Subtitle]: 為什麼? (13) [Subtitle]: 真的蠻多人是「從頭剝」. (14) [Subtitle]: 頭很難剝耶. (15) [Subtitle]: 我媽媽都是從頭. (16) [Subtitle]: 妳媽媽都是從頭剝? (17) [Subtitle]: 你們兩個好怪喔！ (18) [Subtitle]: 我跟你講這次... 我們絕對不會是孤單的. (19) [Subtitle]: 大家留言你的橘子是從... 「尾巴/屁股剝」vs「頭剝」. (20) [Variety]: 沒看過從屁股! 人家從頭剝啊. (21) [Subtitle]: 直接手直接這樣啊！ (22) [Variety]: (攝影師示範中). (23) [Subtitle]: 頭很硬內. 先挖掉頭之後. (24) [Variety]: 這樣就會有一個洞啊. (25) [Subtitle]: 可是從屁股也會有一個洞啊！ (26) [Subtitle]: 妳要怎麼弄? 這樣妳就會覺得... 橘子皮就深深的陷入你的指甲. (27) [Subtitle]: 都在妳指甲裡欸... 呃... 我錯了.
